title: CV Tutorial — chapters 06–10 evidence register
scope: This ledger lists claim/source pairs; does not assert historical benchmark reproduction.

entries.claim: Autograd tracks dynamic graphs and gradients accumulate on leaf tensors; eval and inference_mode are separate
entries.boundary: Examples verify local shapes/gradients, not convergence on a benchmark

entries.claim: ILSVRC 2012 defines ImageNet-1K benchmark; train/validation/test protocols should be kept distinct
entries.boundary: Top-k and confusion matrix are deterministic pedagogical samples

entries.claim: Original AlexNet has five conv and three FC layers; original top-5 winner error is 15.3% vs 26.2% runner-up
entries.boundary: Competition submission is not single torchvision pretrained validation result; modern stem shape has explicit padding

entries.claim: Current torchvision AlexNet is structurally not a literal reproduction of original 96-channel first convolution/two-GPU partition
entries.boundary: Model API/version can change; do not compare parameters without a pinned version

entries.claim: VGG increases depth through small 3x3 filters to 16–19 weight layers; VGG16 config D uses 13 conv + 3 FC
entries.boundary: The figures use stage geometry from stated 224 input and no-BN variant

entries.claim: Classic torchvision vgg16 no-BN reports 138,357,544 parameters
entries.boundary: FC1 102,764,544 is calculated from 7*7*512*4096+4096, not benchmark metric

entries.claim: Paper Table 2 reports Plain-18 27.94, ResNet-18 27.88, Plain-34 28.54 and ResNet-34 25.03 Top-1 error
entries.boundary: ImageNet validation, 10-crop; ResNet option A, not current torchvision defaults

entries.claim: v2 pre-activation and torchvision v1.5 stride variant are different from original v1
entries.boundary: Derivative I+JF only holds at pre-activation addition node, not automatically after ReLU
